BQ25100 regulation can reach 4.23 V; pack specifies 4.20 V CC/CV, with no approved +30 mV charging window. A PCM overvoltage trip is NOT a permitted CV limit. Obtain written pack compatibility for the full tolerance or redesign the charger; USB-only testing with both cells disconnected. One good measured unit is not qualification.
6/6 hidden host lands registered to Seeed module refs/nets; battery pads have 1.7812 × 1.0160 mm nominal bounding-rectangle overlap. No solder paste/reflow/yield proof.

Lower-bound budget, not prediction: right driver alone draws 6.64 or 12.17 mAh/day for 1 h active + 7 h idle, assuming perfect gating 16 h. At Z-Tap-disabled typical idle that leaves 0.200 mA mean for both MCU/radio and all other right-half loads. Z-Tap-enabled idle alone would exceed the 11.43 mAh/day target. Host event suppression is not a measured sensor mode.

12 observed ZMK native events match independent sequence: motion, left held during drag, release, wheel on both axes, return to cursor, right held then release. This did not exercise real PS/2, split BLE, USB or hardware wake.

E03/E04: rail startup and backfeed, both battery-only current integrals, sleep/wake and seven-day runtime not measured.
E05: closed-case BLE range/reconnect, hand attenuation and loss under load unmeasured.
H01–H04: real host USB/BLE, cross-half drag and scroll, disconnects and recovery not exercised.
